title.narrative: Advancing Teacher Readiness for Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation in Education in Tanzania

description.narrative: Advancing Teacher Readiness for Artificial Intelligence in Education in Tanzania is a national capacity-building initiative aimed at strengthening teachers’ understanding and effective use of artificial intelligence (AI) in teaching and learning. Through a series of interactive webinars, the initiative will introduce teachers to emerging AI technologies, their pedagogical applications, ethical considerations, and opportunities for enhancing learner engagement, assessment, and instructional practice. Drawing on UNESCO’s normative guidance, including the AI Competency Framework for Teachers, the initiative will promote responsible, inclusive, and human-centred approaches to AI integration in education while fostering a community of practice for knowledge sharing and professional learning among educators across Tanzania.
